activities.title: New East Coast omakase — book this week
activities.description: A newly opened counter-style Japanese spot near the East Coast has been lighting up food round-ups for its short seasonal menu. Small seats, so weekends fill fast — weekday dinner is the smart play.
activities.parking: Street lots along East Coast Rd fill early; Parkway Parade multi-storey (~5–8 min walk) is the reliable backup. Check Parking.sg for evening rates.
activities.when: Dinner sittings; confirm booking windows on their page
activities.why: New flavour, full restaurant (not a café), and still early enough to get a table if you move this week.

activities.title: Duxton pop-up — limited label drop
activities.description: A short-run concept retail pop-up has landed around Duxton / Keong Saik with a label you won’t find in the usual malls. Worth a focused 45-minute browse before it packs up.
activities.parking: Amara / Icon Village multi-storey. Weekday late afternoon is easier than Saturday noon.
activities.when: Pop-up window this month — confirm end date on the listing
activities.why: Time-limited and novel — the opposite of a neighbourhood you already know cold.

activities.title: Expo public fair — this weekend only
activities.description: Large-scale consumer fair open to the public at Singapore Expo this weekend. Unusual density of stalls and demos you won’t get mid-week in town. Fully AC — plan 2–3 hours.
activities.parking: Expo multi-storey — arrive early on Saturday. Some ticket tiers include parking perks; check the event page.
activities.when: Public days typically 10am–7pm — verify on singaporeexpo.com.sg
activities.why: Unusual scale + only-this-weekend energy. Your Expo sweet spot.

activities.title: New TP bar — weekday launch happy hour
activities.description: A recently opened bar in the Tanjong Pagar / Telok Ayer pocket is running a strong weekday afternoon promo to build the after-work crowd. Cold beer, AC, and a menu that goes beyond bar snacks.
activities.parking: Guoco Tower / nearby multi-storey. Weekday 4–6pm is workable; avoid 7pm peak.
activities.when: Mon–Fri roughly 4pm–7pm launch promo — confirm board specials
activities.deal: Launch-period selected 1-for-1 or house beer specials — check HappyHourLah + venue IG this week.
activities.why: New venue + real afternoon deal. Worth the drive once while the promo is hot.

activities.title: New northern restaurant — short drive
activities.description: A just-opened full-service restaurant in the north has been showing up in recent round-ups (interesting regional menu, not café territory). Perfect when you want something new without a full town trip.
activities.parking: Usually mall- or HDB-adjacent multi-storey nearby — confirm on the venue page. North parking is typically easier than CBD.
activities.when: Dinner Wed–Sun; lunch if they open midweek
activities.why: New menu + near-home drive. Discovery without the PIE crawl.

activities.title: Current ArtScience exhibition (AC day)
activities.description: The rotating exhibition currently on at ArtScience Museum — check what’s installed this month. Fully indoor, high production value, and a clean rainy-day or brutal-heat plan that still feels like an outing.
activities.parking: MBS / Marina Square multi-storey. Some tickets include parking validation — check current offers.
activities.why: What’s on now — not a generic “go to the museum sometime.”

activities.title: Keong Saik new concept store
activities.description: A newly opened independent concept space on/near Keong Saik has been flagged for clothing and objects you won’t see in big department stores. Pair with a new dinner nearby if the browse lands.
activities.parking: Nearby hotel/mall multi-storey; street lots scarce on weekends.
activities.when: Afternoons into evening; closed days vary — check listing
activities.why: New retail address, not a familiar strip you’ve already mapped.

activities.title: Orchard limited drop / new concept floor
activities.description: Scan for a limited collaboration or newly opened concept corner along Orchard (ION / Takashimaya / standalone). Only go if there’s a specific new listing this week — not for a general mall walk.
activities.parking: ION / Wisma linked multi-storey; weekday free-parking promos with spend still appear — check boards.
activities.when: Any day 11am–9pm; weekday afternoons for stock
activities.why: Targeted new drop — skip if nothing fresh is listed this week.
